inputs.drivers: State-linked threats; critical-infrastructure targeting; AI-augmented attacks; NIS2 and DORA; cloud, SASE, identity, and OT adoption; board focus; platform consolidation; valuation discipline.
inputs.invalidation: Expectations are already priced, bundling wins, AI defence commoditises, budgets slow, vendor trust events occur, or regulated customers recover rather than absorb costs.
inputs.seed_claim: Cybersecurity spending is shifting from discretionary IT hygiene toward geopolitical, regulatory, and operational-continuity infrastructure.
inputs.supporting_evidence: The seed identifies CRWD, PANW, FTNT, ZS, OKTA, CACI, PLTR, and CEG as hypotheses and requires ARR, billings, RPO, awards, margins, and free cash flow to validate the shift.
inputs.value_chain: Endpoint and XDR; firewall and SASE; identity; threat intelligence; OT and managed services; integrators; government, utility, industrial, and enterprise customers.

objective: Research one cybersecurity resilience and continuity investment idea.
